source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
2. Provide the vehicle information: Include the make, model, year, VIN (Vehicle Identification Number), license plate number, and mileage of the vehicle being inspected.

3. Date and time: Record the exact date and time when the inspection was performed.

4. Inspector details: List the inspector's name, ID, and any relevant qualifications or certifications.

5. Testing environment and conditions: Note the location, whether the test was conducted on a flat surface, and any other environmental conditions (such as weather) that may be relevant.

6. Brake test procedure: Describe the test procedure followed. This may include a description of whether the test was a pedal to the metal application, a "squeeze" test, a pressure gauge test, or an on-the-road test.

7. Observations: Detail any unusual observations during the test, such as noises from the brakes when applied (screeching, grinding, etc.), any vibration in the steering wheel or pedal
